name: Changelog Bot
description: Previews release changelogs before updating the configured changelog.
about: Prepares a release changelog from the repository’s history and release context. It previews the generated result before a confirmed update, using @nyaomaru/changelog-bot rather than reimplementing its logic.
features: Inspect release context from Git history
examplePrompt: Prepare a dry-run changelog preview using the release tag and version indicated by this repository.
